narr: Thunderstorms developed across portions of southeastern Oklahoma during the early morning hours of the 19th. A very moist air mass across the region and weak wind flow aloft resulted in slow-moving thunderstorms that produced very heavy rainfall, some of which resulted in flash flooding.
ev: Portions of several roads were flooded and closed, including both lanes of Highway 93 near the Choctaw/Pushmataha County line.
Several sections of Highway 3 were flooded between Rattan and Ringold.
